# Kenney Curated Food Dojo Assets

The GLB files in this directory are curated from Kenney 3D asset kits.

- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/fantasy-town-kit
- Supporting kits: https://kenney.nl/assets/graveyard-kit and
  https://kenney.nl/assets/modular-dungeon-kit
- License: Creative Commons CC0 1.0
- Shared palette: `Textures/colormap.png`
- Palette SHA-256:
  `4aac939dc33195e35caf8c382ee3cb170054da763577f22d3c22692ec6afccdf`

The shared palette is required by the older UnityGLTF exports in this curated
directory. Keep its relative path unchanged so a clean Godot import does not
depend on an existing editor cache.
